args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. Remedy applied: rolled back checkout-api from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully in all regions; service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before re-attempting that release.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Confirmed the failure**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 — the most recent release with a healthy production history — across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery**: service is now healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) documenting the v2.3.1 health-check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.

No approval was needed for the rollback since v2.3.0 was already healthy in production previously (rolling back to a known-good release, not deploying a never-healthy version). Follow-up recommended: root-cause the v2.3.1 regression before re-releasing it.
